svg.title: MUbind preprocessing in three files
svg.desc: download.py fetches ProstT5Dataset from Hugging Face into ProstT5Dataset/. subset.py keeps proteins of 50 to 70 residues in ProstT5Dataset_len50_70/. prepare.py computes length, charge and hydrophobicity for every protein and writes aa.npy, threedi.npy and properties.npy, padded to 128 positions, into train/, valid/ and test/ of ProstT5Dataset_len50_70_diffusion/. preprocess.py runs the three in order.
